messages:
Anika (People Ops): Heads up Raj needs his EAD renewal documents couriered to counsel this afternoon. Can someone confirm whether reception can accept an envelope with originals?

Raj (New Hire): I can bring everything by 3pm. Originals include passport, EAD card, and I-94. Do you need copies notarized?

Maya (Immig Legal): Notarization not necessary for our filing, but we do need originals for the envelope. Please include a signed authorization form (link below).

Anika (People Ops): Authorization form: https://redwood.internal/ops/immigration/authorization-form.pdf. Tom, can reception hold the package and label it for DHL pickup at 3:30?

Tom (Facilities): Reception can hold. We'll pre-print a DHL waybill if you drop items by 3:10. Put "Immigration - Maya" on the front.

Raj (New Hire): I'll drop off at 3:05. Also have a question about travel: will submitting renewal affect my travel outside US this week?

Maya (Immig Legal): If renewal is pending and you leave the US, re-entry depends on visa status; recommend avoiding travel until we confirm. DM me your timeline and I'll advise.

Anika (People Ops): Action: Raj to drop originals at reception 3:05; Tom to hold and hand to DHL at 3:30; Maya will confirm receipt once docketed. I'll create expense in Expensify and tag "immigration-shipping".

ExpenseBot (bot): Expense template created: "immigration-shipping-1799123456". Add receipt upload within 7 days.

Raj (New Hire): Dropped off. Reception gave me a sticker and signed receipt. Thanks all.

Maya (Immig Legal): Received tracking 9876543210. ETA counsel: 2026-04-02 10:00 ET. Filing priority: standard. I'll update once entered in the case management system.
